answer: No firm renewal date is settled by the records. The Helix Supplier Renewal page records two conflicting dates: the October 20 purchasing note gives December 3, 2026, and the October 20 legal note gives December 10, 2026. The page states that neither note supersedes the other and that the renewal date is unresolved. The Helix Labs December 1, 2026 renewal is an unrelated internal training subscription. The Helix-Sandbox (February 5, 2027) and Helix-Legacy renewal entries are different suppliers and do not answer this question.
